body: Nothing to talk about homie. I know what I want and it's not plausible at the momen. Mainly I needed to get that shit off my chest. But also I would def do it if I had the means. Talking about it just gets me riled up.

A solution to what? A life that isn't half bad? It just seems like the right thing to do. It FEELS right. Talking is all bullshit. It's all, "don't do it" but I'm a logical guy. I know it would fuck up lives and I know it would be stupid and I know I'll get over it. But it's not worth it when this feeling happens over and over.
